note: Reversible flagged change with a real plan, plus an ~80KB lockfile diff. The lockfile cannot make the change hard to undo, so it must not make the diff count as truncated.
title: Add search suggestions behind a flag and bump dependencies
body:
Adds suggestions.

Reversal Trigger: search error rate > 2% for 5 minutes, watched by the search on-call.
Rollback Path: set flag NEW_SEARCH=off in the config service (takes effect in under a minute), or revert this PR.
Owner: search on-call
